title: JigSLO: Solving the Resource Puzzle for Efficient Multi-LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2509.06261v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: GPU spatial sharing co-locates instances with complementary demands, such as compute-bound prefill and memory-bound decode, promising cost-efficient multi-LLM serving. Prior systems partition compute and coordinate shared memory capacity, but do not model bandwidth contention among co-located instances of heterogeneous LLMs. This contention makes each instance's latency depend on the memory-access patterns of its co-runners, even when its own resource allocation remains unchanged. Drawing on extensive measurements, we find that the latency impact of bandwidth contention can be captured by a time-shared memory-access model with contended and uncontended periods, so the overall latency can be analytically estimated as a time-weighted average of the latency estimates for these periods. We propose JigSLO, a contention-aware multi-LLM serving system that manages memory resources and schedules each model's prefill and decode phases a

translated_title: JigSLO：解决资源拼图难题，实现高效的多LLM服务
translated_abstract: GPU空间共享将具有互补需求的实例（如计算受限的预填充prefill与内存受限的解码decode）共置运行，有望实现低成本高效的多LLM服务。先前的系统对计算进行划分并协调共享内存容量，但并未对异构LLM共置实例之间的带宽竞争进行建模。这种竞争使得每个实例的延迟取决于其共同运行实例的内存访问模式，即使其自身的资源分配保持不变。基于大量测量，我们发现带宽竞争对延迟的影响可以通过一个包含竞争期与非竞争期的时间共享内存访问模型来刻画，因此整体延迟可以解析地估计为这些时期延迟估计值的时间加权平均。我们提出JigSLO，一个感知竞争的多LLM服务系统，它管理内存资源并调度每个模型的预填充和解码阶段，以实现高效的共置服务。
tldr: JigSLO通过时间共享内存访问模型解析估计带宽竞争对延迟的影响，并据此管理内存资源、调度prefill与decode阶段，实现高效的GPU空间共享多LLM服务。
en_tdlr: JigSLO is a contention-aware multi-LLM serving system that analytically estimates the latency impact of bandwidth contention via a time-shared memory-access model, and leverages this to manage memory resources and schedule prefill/decode phases for efficient GPU spatial-sharing serving.
